prompt: A photorealistic photo captures a bustling school science fair. In the center stands a tall volcano model erupting with red foam. To the left of the volcano, a boy in a blue tie observes the eruption closely. Next to him sits a girl with pigtails holding a clipboard. A teacher in a gray suit points at the bubbling lava flow. On the right side of the frame, a robot on wheels moves slowly across the floor. A child in a yellow shirt reaches out to touch the metal chassis of the robot. Behind the robot, a poster board displays complex diagrams. A man in a red scarf leans against the poster board, looking amused. Near the entrance, a brown dog sniffs a discarded candy wrapper. The dog is next to a trash can overflowing with paper cups. A woman in a green dress pulls the leash of the brown dog gently. In the foreground, a solar panel array tilts toward the ceiling lights. A student with glasses adjusts the angle of the solar panels carefully. Beside the solar setup, a beaker filled with blue liquid sits on a table. A hand wearing a latex glove stirs the blue liquid with a glass rod. Above the scene, a banner hangs from the ceiling beams. Two balloons float near the banner, one pink and one blue. A janitor in a uniform sweeps dust near the back wall. There is no fire alarm visible on the walls. There is no digital screen displaying data. There is no cafeteria food being served. The boy in the blue tie stands firmly. The girl with pigtails sits on a folding chair. The teacher in the gray suit gestures emphatically. The robot on wheels rolls forward steadily. The child in the yellow shirt extends an arm. The man in the red scarf rests his weight. The woman in the green dress holds the leash tight. The student with glasses focuses intently. The janitor in the uniform pushes the broom. The brown dog lowers its nose. The hand wearing a latex grip grips the rod. The solar panel array reflects overhead light. The beaker filled with blue liquid remains stable. The poster board leans slightly backward. The volcano model emits thick foam. The trash can overflows visibly. The banner sags in the middle. The pink balloon drifts left. The blue balloon drifts right.
